June 12 has been split, because **Herculaneum and Vesuvius** need their own post and should not have to share the room with every stray food note and practical complaint. That focused post is here: [Herculaneum and Vesuvius](herculaneum-vesuvius.qmd).

This general note keeps the rest of the day: Naples logistics, food, and whatever details do not belong inside the archaeology-and-volcano post.

The practical lesson of the day remains excellent and irritating: hiking poles can cross the Atlantic, survive the packing system, sit ready for exactly the right day, and still not make it to **Mount Vesuvius**. A small lesson in logistics, paid for on volcanic gravel.

Food notes began to collect around the edges of the day as well: **CROCCANTI**, and pizza at **10 Diego** — specifically **PARIGINA**. The pizza picture now has its own post: [Pizza at 10 Diego Vitagliano](pizza-at-10-diego-vitagliano.qmd). This is good, because some things should be documented visually before anyone tries to improve them with prose.
